name: Mem0 open-source memory library
description: Open-source Mem0 library (mem0ai) that extracts memories from conversations with an LLM and stores them in a configurable vector store (default local Qdrant) plus a SQLite history store. Scoped by user_id, agent_id and run_id. The managed Mem0 Platform is a separate offering.

provenance.notes: Supports backing_type vector: 22 Python vector store providers; 'Qdrant will be used as the vector database' by default.
Supports library defaults: OpenAI LLM and embeddings, local Qdrant, SQLite history at ~/.mem0/history.db.
expiration_date hides a memory from search but does not delete it, so supports_ttl is deliberately not asserted.
